title: Outlook: Grid keyboard navigation in calendar month view via arrow keys in new Outlook for Windows and Web
description: When focused on the calendar grid, you will be able to navigate the time slots on the calendar via left/right/up/down arrow keys in month view. #newoutlookforwindows
